{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Got the latest doppraymagno scanner, full-range sensor, a self-contained power supply good for a year. It better work, it cost me enough.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
The '''doppraymagno scanner''' was a multifunctional [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. The sensor could look within solid objects using a combination of Doppler imaging, [[X-ray/Legends|X-rays]], and [[Magnetic resonance imager|magnetic resonance]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|200|doppraymagno scanner}}</ref> It was a component of the [[broad-spectrum sensor suite]] used in [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam]]/[[Rhinnal State Medical Academy|RSMA]]'s [[Bioscan Unit]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
